Nvidia’s board held an emergency meeting that ran late into the night after the latest affair reports, and by the end Huang had agreed to step down. The board left him no choice but to resign.

According to people who spoke with him, his usual take-charge style was gone. name: The Kobeissi Letter
text:
BREAKING: An open letter to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia, $NVDA, now has over 65,000 signatures, alleging that Huang was removed "without meaningful due process."

The letter has been signed by more than 35,000 shareholders and 4,700 current and former Nvidia employees.

Elon Musk has publicly stated that he has signed the petition and fully supports Huang's return to the company.

We maintain our view that Huang was removed prematurely, without a conclusive investigation.

name: unusual_whales
text:
BREAKING: Three months ago, Jensen Huang belittled Colette Kress in front of senior executives, calling her “a deer in the headlights.” Now she’s replacing him as Nvidia CEO.

During an August meeting, Huang reportedly cut off his CFO mid-presentation and criticized her in front of the room, per The Wall Street Journal. He dismissed her as a “reporting CFO,” not someone who could help shape strategy or make decisions.
